description: Group G Trading-profile field: slippage_realised_vs_expected. Formula: mean over the window's filled orders of (realised_fill_price - expected_fill_price) in bps of expected_fill_price. This fixture supplies the already-computed per-order bps deltas (the arrival-price mid-quote subtraction itself is order-book plumbing out of this suite's scope) and checks only the window-mean aggregation step.
